WITH category_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        category,
        COUNT(*) as line_count
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY category
),
avg_lines_per_category AS (
    SELECT AVG(line_count) as avg_lines
    FROM category_counts
),
above_avg_categories AS (
    SELECT c.category, c.line_count
    FROM category_counts c
    CROSS JOIN avg_lines_per_category a
    WHERE c.line_count > a.avg_lines
),
category_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        b.category,
        COUNT(*) as num_lines,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount != 0
            THEN (b.spent - b.amount) / CAST(b.amount AS FLOAT)
            ELSE NULL
        END) as avg_overspend
    FROM budget b
    INNER JOIN above_avg_categories aac ON b.category = aac.category
    GROUP BY b.category
)
SELECT 
    AVG(cs.avg_overspend) as avg_relative_overspend,
    AVG(cs.num_lines) as avg_number_of_lines,
    AVG(cs.num_lines) - (SELECT avg_lines FROM avg_lines_per_category) as avg_lines_above_average
FROM category_stats cs
